logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water partition coefficients for Ir1 and Ir2 were determined using the ultraviolet spectrophotometry method with a shake-flask. First, the mixed solution, water (50 mL) and n-octanol (50 mL) was left shaking for 48 h at 37 °C. The organic phase and water phase were used for preparing the complex standard solutions (C = 10 μM). Second, the mixed solvents containing n-octanol (25 mL) and water (25 mL) were used to prepare the complex detection solutions (C = 10 μM) and then shaken for 48 h. Third, using UV spectrophotometry, the concentrations in the organic phase (Co) and the water phase (Cw) of the detecting solutions for the complexes were determined separately. logP, the n-octanol/water partition coefficient, was calculated by the following equation:logP = log(Co/Cw).
